tools.name: about_tandiu_data
tools.description: What data TANDIU publishes, refresh cadence, price basis and how to cite. Call first.

tools.name: list_llm_prices
tools.description: Official API list prices (USD per 1M tokens) with Artificial Analysis, LiveBench and Epoch AI scores for major US and Chinese LLMs. Filter and sort.

tools.name: cheapest_model_for_score
tools.description: Cheapest models whose benchmark score meets a threshold (absolute or percent of the best score).

tools.name: get_price_index
tools.description: Chain-linked LLM price index (CN, US or all models), 30-day change, median price and series.

tools.name: list_price_changes
tools.description: Official list-price cuts/increases observed in daily snapshots, and models newly added to tracking.

tools.name: estimate_self_hosting
tools.description: VRAM, GPUs needed, speed and hardware cost to self-host an open-weights model. Omit model to list available models.

tools.name: list_cloud_agents
tools.description: Cloud agents (one persistent agent per person, team agents, hosting platforms) with specs and monthly prices.

tools.name: recommend_coding_pc
tools.description: Relative speed and tier (best/recommended/minimum/not_advised) of Macs, laptops and desktops for running Codex / Claude Code.

tools.name: list_ai_funding
tools.description: Funding rounds of AI companies (mainly US and China): company, business, round, amount, valuation, investors, source links. Newest first; filter by region, sector, company/investor name, date or minimum amount.
